name: orderproof
description: OrderProof - Dispute-proof ordering for Ghanaian food businesses

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:production: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:production --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
